title: UPSC CSE - Quantitative Ability - Work and Time
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: A, B, C working independently can do a piece of work in 8, 16 and 12 days respectively. A alone works on Monday. B alone works on Tuesday, C alone works on Wednesday, A alone again works on Thursday and so on. Consider the following statements: 1. The work will be finished on Thursday. 2. The work will be finished in 10 days. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: 24 men and 12 women can do a piece of work in 30 days. In how many days can 12 men and 24 women do the same piece of work?
options: Less than 30 days or more than 30 days
Data is inadequate to draw any conclusion
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: A man completes 7/8 of a job in 21 days. How many more days will it take him to finish the job if quantum of work is further increased by 50%?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: P works thrice as fast as Q, whereas P and Q together can work four times as fast as R. If P, Q and R together work on a job, in what ratio should they share the earnings?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: There is an order of 19000 quantity of a particular product from a customer. The firm produces 1000 quantity of that product per out of which 5% are unfit for sale. In how many days will the order be completed?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Ram and Shyam work on a job together for four days and complete 60% of it. Ram takes leave then and Shyam works for eight more days to complete the job. How long would Ram take to complete the entire job alone?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: W can do 25% of a work in 30 days, X can do 1/4 of the work in 10 days, Y can do 40% of the work in 40 days and Z can do 1/3 of the work in 13 days. Who will complete the work first?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Two pipes A and B can independently fill a tank completely in 20 and 30 minutes respectively. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, how much time will they take to fill the tank completely?
questions.subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Consider the following diagrams: x men, working at constant speed, do a certain job in y days. Which one of these diagrams shows the relation between x and y?
